MAPK signaling pathway map of Milk thistle up- and down-regulated genes under drought stress condition

MAPK signaling pathway map of Milk thistle up- and down-regulated genes under drought stress condition. The up-regulated genes are in red, the down-regulated genes are in blue, and the genes that were in both up- and down-regulated gene categories are in yellow

Publication
